y-m-56-03.topic: Ixabiso elincinci lomsebenzi: indlela isiphumo sitshintsha ngayo ngesixeko (uluhlu lwe-x)
y-m-56-03.goal: Yazi ukuba nokuba ulingano lufanayo, ixabiso elincinci kakhulu linokuhlala linjalo, litshintshe, okanye lingabikho kwaphela ngokwoluhlu lwe-x (isixeko), uze wakhe uluhlu oluhambelana nemeko.
y-m-56-03.material: Cinga umsebenzi f(x) = x² − 4x + 5. (x² ifundwa ngokuthi 'x isikwere'.) Amaxabiso ambalwa yi-f(0) = 5, f(1) = 2, f(2) = 1, f(3) = 2, f(4) = 5. Ukuba akukho luhlu lwe-x lunikiweyo, x inokuba naliphi na inani leqinisileyo. Masitshintshe uluhlu lwe-x sibone ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwixabiso elincinci kakhulu (ubuncinane) be-f.

y-m-56-02.material: Igrafu yomsebenzi y = |x| yimilo ye-'V' enencopho ku-(0, 0), apho y = 1 xa x = 1 nakwi-x = −1. (|x| ifundwa 'ixabiso eliphelele lika-x'.) UMinjae wabhala isisombululo sokufumana ukulingana kwegrafu efunyenwe ngokuhambisa le grafu ngama-2 ukuya ekunene (kwicala lepozithivu le-eksisi ye-x).

y-m-56-01.title: Ingaba olu ludibaniso lunokubizwa ngokuba ngumsebenzi?
y-m-56-01.topic: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi: udibaniso apho igalelo ngalinye linika isiphumo esinye kanye
y-m-56-01.goal: Vavanya udibaniso ngalunye ngemeko yokuba igalelo ngalinye linika isiphumo esinye kanye, uhlele ukuba ngowuphi umsebenzi, ulungise udibaniso olungengomsebenzi ukuze lube ngumsebenzi, uze wakhe umsebenzi onelisa imeko ngoluhlu lwawo.
y-m-56-01.material:
Kwiklasi yabafundi abangama-28, umfundi ngamnye unenombolo enye yokuhamba ukusuka ku-1 ukuya kwi-28, yaye wonke umfundi unemini enye kanye yokuzalwa (ungawunaki unyaka obhisekileyo). Udibaniso apho igalelo ngalinye linika isiphumo esinye kanye lubizwa 'ngumsebenzi'. Apha, isiphumo sithetha inani elinye (okanye inombolo yokuhamba enye); iziphumo ezininzi aziqatshelwa njengesixa esinye. Zikho ezine izidibaniso ezingezantsi.
(가) inombolo yokuhamba → inyanga umfundi owazalwa kuyo (ukususela kuJanuwari ukuya kuDisemba)
(나) inyanga yokuzalwa (ukususela kuJanuwari ukuya kuDisemba) → iinombolo zokuhamba zabafundi abazalwa kuloo nyanga
(다) inani lendalo → inani lezahluli zalo nani
(라) inani lendalo → amanani azizahluli zalo nani

y-m-56-01.thinking.2: Yakha imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo enelisa imeko ngoluhlu

y-m-56-01.s.s1.r.c: Esi sigwebo sithi 'inani' lezahluli linani elinye kwinani ngalinye lendalo.

y-m-56-04.topic: Umgama phakathi kwamachaphazelo amabini kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa nonxantathu abalinganayo ngamacala amabini
y-m-56-04.goal: Thelekisa imigama phakathi kwamachaphazelo amabini usebenzisa ii-coordinates, yakha amachaphazelo enza unxantathu olinganayo ngamacala amabini ngeendlela ezininzi ezahlukeneyo, uze ukhethe imeko engeyiyo unxantathu (zonke zisemgceni omnye).
y-m-56-04.material: Kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa kukho A(0, 0) no-B(4, 0). Ufuna ukukhetha ichaphazelo C(x, y) elineecoordinates zombini ezingamanani aphelele wenze unxantathu ABC. Isikwere somgama phakathi kwamachaphazelo amabini yi-(umahluko othe tye) isikwere + (umahluko othe nkqo) isikwere. Ngoko AB² = 16, AC² = x² + y², BC² = (x − 4)² + y². (Ukuthelekisa izikwere zobude kunika isiphumo esifanayo nokuthelekisa ubude ngaphandle kokusebenzisa iingcambu zesikwere.)

y-m-56-05.title: Ukufumana umgca odibana kuphela kwi-(1, 3)

y-m-56-05.goal: Yazi ukuba ukuba imigca emibini idibana na akunakumiselwa ziziphumo zokuzama amaxabiso ambalwa kuphela, wahlule imeko yokudibana kwichaphazelo elinye kuphela (imithambeka eyahlukileyo) kwimeko apho imigca iyadibana, uze wakhe umgca onjalo wena.
y-m-56-05.material: Umgca L yi-y = 2x + 1. Ichaphazelo (1, 3) lisemgceni lo (ukufaka x = 1 kunika y = 3). Ngoku ufuna ukukhetha omnye umgca M wefom y = mx + n (m no-n ngamanani aphelele). Qala ujonge ukuba yeyiphi indlela yokugweba ukuba imigca emibini idibana na ethembekileyo, uze wakhe umgca M odibana no-L kuphela kwi-(1, 3). Cinga umgca njengoqhubekayo ngokungenasiphelo kuwo omabini amacala.

y-m-56-05.s.s1.r.d: Olu gwebo luthi ukuba kukho ichaphazelo lokudibana, kufuneka kubekho i-x apho i-y yeemlinganiselo ezimbini ilingana.
y-m-56-05.s.s1.explain: Ukuba imithambeka iyalingana kwaye ii-y-intercepts ziyahluka, umahluko wamaxabiso amabini e-y sisiqhubekayo 4 kuyo yonke i-x, ngoko imigca ayidibani. Ulingano olwenziwe ngokulinganisa alunakusonjululwa nayiphi na x, olunika isigqibo esifanayo. Ukuzama amaxabiso ambalwa e-x okanye ukuzoba inxalenye yemigca kushiya iindawo ongazivavanyanga, ngoko akunakuqinisekisa 'abadibani' (kunokusetyenziswa ukufumana umzekelo ochasayo obonisa ukuba badibana).
